decks.notes: This Bant Control deck focuses on using a mix of powerful planeswalkers, disruptive spells, and efficient creatures to control the game. Key cards like Tamiyo, Quantum Riddler, and Murktide Regent help generate card advantage and control the board, while Leyline Binding and Swords to Plowshares deal with threats. The deck also features a strong card selection package with Ponder, Brainstorm, and Up the Beanstalk, as well as a suite of counter spells to protect your game plan. Additionally, Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd provides a versatile threat that can help close out the game.

The main concept of this Bant Control deck is to disrupt opponent's plays using counterspells like Force of Will and Force of Negation, removal spells like Swords to Plowshares, and card draw/filtering tools like Brainstorm and Ponder. The deck also utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd to generate card advantage and provide additional control options. Leyline Binding and Quantum Riddler are used to further control the board and slow down the opponent's game plan. Murktide Regent provides a win condition while Up the Beanstalk ramps up mana for casting powerful spells. The deck aims to control the game until it can establish a dominant position and close out the game efficiently.

This deck revolves around utilizing various artifacts and creatures to generate value and control the board. It focuses on synergies between Engineer, Welder, and Cam cards to create powerful combos and lock opponents out of the game. By leveraging the abilities of cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Goblin Engineer, this deck is able to consistently recur key pieces and disrupt opponents' strategies. The addition of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion adds an additional layer of versatility and card advantage to the deck. Overall, this deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents through strong synergies and clever plays.

The main concept of this deck is to disrupt your opponent's strategies while applying pressure with aggressive creatures, utilizing cards like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to control the board. The deck also focuses on generating card advantage with cards like Brainstorm and Recruiter of the Guard, while also flickering creatures for additional value. The inclusion of the companion Yorion, Sky Nomad allows for additional card advantage and synergizes well with the deck's flicker effects. Overall, the deck aims to outmaneuver the opponent through disruption and incremental advantage.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo utilizing cards like Lion's Eye Diamond, Lotus Petal, and Hullbreacher to generate massive card advantage and disrupt opponents' strategies. The deck aims to create a lock by utilizing Narset, Parter of Veils and Day's Undoing to prevent opponents from drawing cards while digging for key pieces. With the ability to quickly generate mana and disrupt opponents' plans, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents and win the game in a single explosive turn.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on aggressively applying pressure with powerful creatures while disrupting the opponent's game plan with targeted removal and hand disruption spells. The deck utilizes a mix of aggressive creatures like Amped Raptor and Guide of Souls, along with efficient removal spells like Swords to Plowshares. Additionally, cards like Cabal Therapy and Thoughtseize provide disruption by stripping important cards from the opponent's hand. The mana base includes various lands for consistency and some disruption with Wasteland.

The main concept of this deck is to be very aggressive and put pressure on the opponent as quickly as possible. The deck includes cards that help with card draw and manipulation to ensure a consistent flow of threats. It also includes a lot of counterspells and removal to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The land base is built to support the deck's color requirements and to disrupt the opponent's mana base with Wasteland. Overall, the deck is designed to be fast, disruptive, and adaptable in order to win the game quickly.

The key concept of this UWx Control deck is to disrupt opponent's strategies using counterspells like Force of Will, classic blue spells like Brainstorm and Stifle, and removal spells like Swords to Plowshares. The deck also aims to control the board with cards like Murktide Regent and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd while generating card advantage with Quantum Riddler and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. The mana base is built to support all three colors with fetchlands and dual lands, while also having some utility lands like Wasteland for disruption.

The deck focuses on using a diverse range of cards to control the game, including counterspells, removal, card draw, and land disruption. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while gaining card advantage through cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Ponder. The deck also includes efficient creatures like Orcish Bowmasters and Quantum Riddler to pressure the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent through a combination of control elements and card advantage.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling the combo of Aluren + Acererak the Archlich + Atraxa, Grand Unifier to create a loop that generates infinite casts of Acererak's ability, allowing you to drain your opponent's life total. The deck also has access to powerful cards like Lotus Petal, Brainstorm, Force of Will, and Show and Tell to help find and protect the combo pieces. With efficient mana sources like Ancient Tomb and City of Traitors, along with the ability to tutor for specific cards with Stock Up and fetch lands, this deck aims to win quickly and decisively.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the combo potential of Aluren with creatures like Acererak the Archlich and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to generate powerful board presence and card advantage. By using cards like Show and Tell and Omniscience, the deck can quickly overwhelm opponents with its creatures and spells. The inclusion of counter spells like Force of Will and Veil of Summer helps protect the combo pieces, while cards like Brainstorm and Ponder help search for key cards. The mana base is structured to support the deck's requirements for various colored mana sources.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling the Aluren combo to generate infinite value by repeatedly casting creatures for free. A mix of powerful creatures and spells support the combo, with cards like Show and Tell and Force of Will allowing for protection and acceleration. The mana base includes a variety of fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistent access to the necessary colors of mana. With careful piloting and timing, the deck can overwhelm opponents with its combo potential and efficient resource management.

This Aluren combo deck aims to quickly assemble the Aluren enchantment to allow players to cast their creatures for free. By utilizing cards like Show and Tell and Omniscience, the deck can cheat out powerful creatures like Atraxa and Emrakul, overwhelming opponents with their presence on the battlefield. The deck also includes protection in the form of Force of Will and Veil of Summer, as well as card draw and manipulation with Brainstorm and Ponder. The goal is to quickly establish a dominant board presence and win the game before opponents can respond effectively.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures alongside disruptive spells and equipment to quickly overwhelm opponents. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while putting pressure on them with efficient creatures such as Thalia and Stoneforge Mystic. The addition of Yorion as a companion provides additional value and flexibility to the deck. The deck also includes a combination of removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Solitude to deal with threats. Overall, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining a strong aggressive presence on the board.

The deck revolves around utilizing lands as a resource to control the game, using cards like Crop Rotation, Life from the Loam, and Exploration to generate advantage. Urza's Saga is a key card that allows for powerful land tutor effects, while Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage provide a combo win condition. Additionally, there are disruptive elements like Mox Diamond, Wasteland, and Boseiju, Who Endures to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to control the board and outvalue the opponent through efficient land manipulation and powerful synergies.

The deck focuses on generating mana quickly through artifact acceleration and rituals, before using tutors to find key combo pieces like Ad Nauseam, Tendrils of Agony, and Infernal Tutor. It aims to cast multiple spells in a single turn to build storm count and win the game with a large Tendrils of Agony or other lethal spell. The deck is designed to be resilient against disruption with Duress, Thoughtseize, and Wishclaw Talisman to find answers or protect the combo. Using Urza's Saga, the deck can also tutor for key artifacts to enhance its combo potential.
